content.title: Why Champion Homes (SKY) Shares Are Sliding Today
content.summary: Shares of modular home and building manufacturer Champion Homes (NYSE:SKY) fell 3% in the afternoon session after the homebuilding sector faced pressure after competitors NVR, Inc. and M/I Homes released disappointing third-quarter results. NVR reported that its net income fell by 20% and revenue declined. The company also saw a 16% decrease in new orders and a higher cancellation rate, which climbed to 19%.
